# Blue Cutie

Blue Cutie is the aqua-and-magenta Earth pony dancing behind Sapphire Shores, the Pony of Pop, in *Friendship is Magic*. Remember her as the pink-haired dancer immediately to the left of Sapphire in the still below.

[![Blue Cutie, second from left — My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic, Hasbro/DHX Media](https://derpicdn.net/img/download/2024/4/15/3344139__safe_screencap_blue%2Bcutie_foxxy%2Btrot_icy%2Bpassion_sapphire%2Bshores_signature%2Bmoves_earth%2Bpony_pony_unicorn_for%2Bwhom%2Bthe%2Bsweetie%2Bbelle%2Btoils_g4_my%2Blittle%2B.png)](https://derpibooru.org/images/3344139)

- **Appearance:** Pale turquoise coat, swept magenta mane and tail, deep pink eyes, and a purple dance outfit with pink trim. Her cutie mark is unverified.
- **Name:** Blue Cutie is a fandom name; its original coiner is unknown. Gameloft's licensed mobile game identifies her as **Sapphire Shores' Dancer**, with a biography referencing Sweetie Belle's dreams. Neither name is established as spoken in the television episode. See the [Earth pony character catalog](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Earth_ponies/Mares) and [game roster](https://mlp-gameloft.fandom.com/wiki/Characters/R_-_T).
- **Speaking status:** No identifiable individual dialogue or voice credit found.
- **Appearances:** Television debut in *For Whom the Sweetie Belle Toils* (S4E19, March 22, 2014). The character catalog also identifies her in IDW's *Friends Forever* #37 (2017), featuring Sapphire's concert preparations, and notes a lookalike in *Friendship is Magic* #22, page 1. The comic identification is secondary-source evidence, not independently confirmed.

## Important moments

Both scenes are from *For Whom the Sweetie Belle Toils* (S4E19); [episode transcript](https://www.springfieldspringfield.co.uk/view_episode_scripts.php?episode=s04e19&tv-show=my-little-pony-friendship-is-magic) (video timestamps unavailable).

- **A nightmare of ruined costumes:** The dancer appears in Sweetie Belle's vision of the consequences of sabotaging Rarity's headdress, illustrating the stakes of the costume commission.
- **Canterlot rehearsal:** Blue Cutie performs with Sapphire's backup troupe as Rarity watches, establishing her recognizable role before Sweetie Belle attempts to retrieve and repair the headdress.

She has no verified independent character arc or consequential solo decision. The show still was visually verified; the Derpibooru post is indexed but returned a 403 on direct access. The Fandom pages were available through indexed excerpts only. No independently attributed fan art or exact video timestamps were verified.
